name: menu
summary: Runs one action from a list that opens over the page: the arrows move through the items and stop on a disabled one, where Enter chooses nothing; Enter on another item chooses it, and Escape closes the list, each with focus back on the trigger.

notCovered.name: submenus
notCovered.why: A ui-menu-sub opens a second list from an item. The stage shows one level, so the second list and its trigger's arrow are never drawn here.

notCovered.name: checkbox and radio items
notCovered.why: UI SDK draws their check as a masked box, and a mask on the page changes how the hosted browser draws text elsewhere on it. The stage holds none.

notCovered.name: groups, separators, shortcuts and item icons
notCovered.why: Their looks are UI SDK's own; the stage holds none, so no light reads them.
